newsitem.title: USA: Baltimore council reverses property tax cut--paper.
newsitem.headline: Baltimore council reverses property tax cut--paper.

text.p: Baltimore's City Council late Thursday enacted then reversed a property tax cut, but Mayor Kurt Schmoke said he would not spend the $4.5 million restored to the budget by the move, the Baltimore Sun reported Friday.
The council at first approved a five-cent reduction in the tax, but later reversed the cut in a move aimed at persuading Schmoke not to reduce spending on parks and recreation.
By the end of the budget battle, Baltimore's property tax rate remained unchanged at $5.85 per $100 of assessed value.
Schmoke, who certified the budget Thursday, said he would not spend the restored money, but was also not going to fight with the council anymore, the newspaper said.
